question: What share of 2025 quotes for drivers aged 17-24 converted into policies?
final_text:
About 12.6% of 2025 quotes for drivers aged 17-24 converted. Of 14,645 quotes, 1,841 were bound to a policy term (1,841 / 14,645 = 0.1257).

I counted a quote as converted when it has a bound term ID. All 1,841 of those IDs are distinct and match a real policy term, so no quote is double-counted.

ANSWER: 0.1257

input.query: select driver_age_band, count(*), count(bound_term_id) from quote where year(quote_date)=2025 group by 1 order by 1

select count(*), count(distinct q.bound_term_id), count(t.term_id) from quote q left join policy_term t on t.term_id=q.bound_term_id where year(quote_date)=2025 and driver_age_band='17-24' and q.bound_term_id is not null
